In E-RUN Issue 34: Magnetic Alchemy, we explore ferrofluidics as the ultimate dynamic accessory. Composed of nanoscale ferromagnetic particles suspended in organic carrier oil, this liquid metal morphs from smooth ribbons into dramatic, spiky architectural crowns the exact second our hidden magnetic coils activate. Your neckline adapts from soft evening elegance to formidable spikes at the flick of a switch.

If your jewelry morphed its shape based on magnetic fields around you, would you prefer **Fluid Ribbons** or **Sharp Spikes**? 🧲💬
